notes: OpenCode 2.x, driven through the service API (#2109 P5a smoke cell). ready → working → waiting while a shell ask is held 10s, then the API reply and the turn's end in ready. The permission is traced through the 2.x plugin's permission.asked / permission.replied hooks (#2108). No post-reply working is asserted: the #1366 waiting-exit dwell swallows it when the turn ends within ~6s of the reply (measured in P4: 3.4s and 4.6s). The post-turn ready → working → ready bounce is anchored past (#2109 §6 Q2 default).

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — P4's 1 Hz sampler first saw an API session as working, so V1's 'born ready within 2s' is not assumed
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
The tool-inducing prompt drives the session to working
The 2.x plugin forwards permission.asked to the daemon
The held ask puts the session in waiting (rule 0: PermissionPending)
After the reply the turn completes back to ready; no post-reply working is asserted (#1366 dwell)
